decision.scope: Precommitted research review rule; no model promotion or all-map victory claim.

chronology.recovery_timing_note: Start-only job intervals resolved by a later successful attempt retain their raw journal; their endpoint is bounded by the next attempt start for containment only. Peak concurrency excludes these unobserved durations.
chronology.timestamp_provenance: Original-run file mtimes were observed with their exact artifact SHA; restored audits reuse these saved observations, never checkout mtimes. Embedded start/end journals independently establish execution order. These are provenance consistency checks, not a trusted-clock attestation.

decision.scope: Preregistered small research experiment only; neither 74-map qualification nor model promotion.

limitations: No new Java games or engine replay were run by this auditor. Recorded terminal world, action transcript, frozen source, root prefix and model-input hashes are cross-checked; engine authenticity and first-eligible-turn extraction and the underlying streaming reservoir sampling remain dependent on the audited frozen engine/collector implementation.

Thirty-two target roots and sixteen held roots form a small paired mechanism experiment. The fresh benchmark panel contains one map and seed, two seats per opponent; it cannot establish all-map superiority.

The frozen v6 actor scanner can skip matching processes when /proc cwd is unreadable across sandbox namespaces. This standalone final audit instead blocks matching commands conservatively on cwd read failure, holds all four exclusion locks, and never relies on the frozen scanner for final quiescence.
Independent SGD replay operates only on in-memory copies of cached features and frozen baseline heads; it produces no saved training state or promoted candidate.

quiescence.unreadable_cwd_policy: Matching actor or EngineBridge commands block conservatively when /proc cwd cannot be read.
